lines.en: It hovers, neither forward nor back.

lines.zh: 它的金属外壳在暗处发亮
lines.en: Its metal shell shines in the dark.
Every movement makes a small sound.

lines.zh: 它的圆盘在身侧慢慢转
lines.en: Its disc turns slowly at its side.

lines.zh: 它升到与人齐高的位置

lines.en: It drifts out of the tree shadow.
Its path is a straight line.

lines.zh: 它朝你的方向移动过来

lines.en: Light shows in the seams of its shell.
It turns its head a full circle.
Then it stops for a moment.
Then returns to its old frequency.
It holds in the air without a quiver.

lines.zh: 它把身体转了很小的角度
lines.en: It turns its body a very small angle.
It holds in the air as if pinned.

lines.zh: 圆盘的边缘映出一点光
lines.en: A glint runs along the disc's edge.
No dust rests on its shell.

lines.zh: 它发出一声确认的短鸣
lines.en: It gives a short confirming tone.

lines.zh: 它靠近了一点，又退回去
它的动作像在比对什么
它围着你缓缓划过半圈
lines.en: It slides a slow half circle around you.
It stops there for a long while.

lines.zh: 它把你的形状扫了一遍
它的圆盘转得慢了一些

lines.en: It is deciding whether to approach.

lines.zh: 原吉兹兽晃了一下，稳住

lines.en: It emits a string of short tones.
A mark appears on its shell.

lines.zh: 它的圆盘转速慢了下来

lines.en: It rises half a block, clear.
It locks on to you again.

lines.zh: 原吉兹兽扫了一眼你手上的东西

lines.en: It turns the item toward the light.
It takes two tries to stow it.
What it cannot use, it drops.
It puts the hand out again.
It slots the item into a shell seam.
It returns to place and quiets.

lines.zh: 它把东西的重量算了一遍
它对你手上的材质很挑剔
lines.en: It is picky about the material.
You hit ProtoGizmon; it is hard.

lines.zh: 它的圆盘擦过你的手臂

lines.en: It goes around you, changing heading.

lines.zh: 它低头看了看相撞的地方
lines.en: It looks at the point of contact.
It backs off half a block.
It hovers, waiting for you to move.

lines.zh: 两台原吉兹兽并排悬着

lines.en: They trade a run of short tones.
Light in their seams pulses together.
They rise to the same height.
They make a slow half circle.
Then each returns to its place.

lines.zh: 它们的低鸣合成一个音
lines.en: Their hums merge into one note.

lines.zh: 原吉兹兽伸手拾起东西

lines.en: It holds it before the disc.
It passes a light over it.
Then stows it with a short arm.
It discards what it cannot use.
It sets the item in front of itself.

lines.zh: 原吉兹兽的低鸣变了调

lines.en: The seams of its shell brighten a notch.

lines.zh: 它朝你的方向倾了一点

lines.en: The short tones become one long note.
There is a pressure in the air.

lines.zh: 它保持着一个固定的距离

lines.en: Its disc stays aimed at you.
It rises to look from above.
Its arm rises to shoulder height.
The disc shrieks across your armour.
A short arm strikes your chest.

lines.zh: 圆盘回旋回来，又切一刀
lines.en: The disc circles back for another cut.
It withdraws and the disc returns.
A second throw comes in lower.
The disc's edge is very thin.

lines.zh: 接缝里的光一点点亮起

lines.en: It turns slowly toward the ground.

lines.zh: 然后下降到你视线的高度
lines.en: Then descends to your eye level.

lines.zh: 它的外壳上没有一点划痕

lines.en: It hovers and gives a short tone.

lines.zh: 然后整台身体才显出来
lines.en: Then the rest of the body shows.

lines.zh: 它慢慢调整悬停的高度

lines.en: Its light is very visible in the dark.

lines.zh: 外壳被烤得发烫，它急着升高
lines.en: Its shell heats and it climbs fast.

lines.zh: 进水后它的低鸣变成杂音
lines.en: Water turns its hum to static.

lines.zh: 冲击把它推得横移数格
lines.en: The blast slides it several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭撞上外壳，叮一声弹开
lines.en: An arrow rings off its shell.

lines.zh: 怪力钻进来，接缝的光乱跳
lines.en: Odd force enters; the seams jump.

lines.zh: 能量不足，它的动作变慢
lines.en: Low on power, its movements drag.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着外壳走，光全灭了
lines.en: Lightning crawls the shell; the lights die.

lines.zh: 虚空吸它，圆盘却还在转
lines.en: The void pulls; the disc keeps turning.
